english.note: Use this for something physically bending or curving, especially when it sags downward under weight.
Use 彎 when something becomes curved or is described as having curved.

examples.english: This shelf will bow downward with so much stuff on it.
examples.traditional: 呢個層架擺得太多嘢，會向下彎。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 cang4 gaa3 baai2 dak1 taai3 do1 je5 wui5 hoeng3 haa6 waan1

examples.english: It is easy to bend this wire.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tit3 sin3 hou2 jung4 ji6 waan1
